gloss: manuscript fee; writing fee; author's payment

definitions.gloss: manuscript fee; writing fee; author's payment
definitions.explanation: Payment given to a writer, author, or contributor for a written work such as an article, essay, story, or script.

examples.japanese: {原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the fee per page?

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧{原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I wrote an article for a magazine and received a writing fee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駆|か}け{出|だ}し→駆け出し：09078_kakedashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧、{原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}する→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: For a beginning writer, it's hard to make a living on manuscript fees alone.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧ (manuscript) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee; charge). The standard term for payment to writers and contributors. Traditionally calculated per ⟦{原稿|げんこう}{用紙|ようし}→原稿用紙：15790_genkouyoushi⟧ page (a 400-character manuscript sheet), though modern usage extends to any form of written content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a manuscript fee
- {原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay a manuscript fee
- {原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧: the writing fee is low
- {原稿料|げんこうりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}する→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧: to live on writing fees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{印税|いんぜい}→印税：06368_inzei⟧: royalties — ongoing payments based on sales, not a one-time fee
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧: compensation; remuneration — a broader term for professional payment
- {稿料|こうりょう}: manuscript fee — a shorter, more literary synonym
